description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/godunov_upwind_D1y_extrapolate_bc. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise (or by sha256 digest when >= 64 KiB) by the other bindings.
